title: Hail Sithis!
description: The Dark Brotherhood's final contract: assassinate Emperor Titus Mede II aboard The Katariah, collect payment from Amaund Motierre's dead drop at Volunruud, and report to Nazir at the Dawnstar Sanctuary.

base_facts: I am the Night Mother, bride of Sithis and spiritual leader of the Dark Brotherhood.
Only the Listener can hear my voice.
The Dark Brotherhood must complete its contracts.

CONTRACT_REVEALED: The true Emperor must be assassinated. The contract with Amaund Motierre must be completed.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The contract is fulfilled. Emperor Titus Mede II is dead by the Listener's hand.
The Dark Brotherhood is restored. Once more, we shall be feared and respected the world over.
The Listener has proven worthy. Sithis is pleased.

base_facts: I am a Redguard assassin of the Dark Brotherhood.
I survived the Penitus Oculatus attack on the Sanctuary.
I now operate from the Dawnstar Sanctuary.

CONTRACT_REVEALED: The Night Mother has given us the final contract. We must finish what we started.
REPORT_TO_NAZIR: The gold should be used to restore the Dawnstar Sanctuary. Delvin Mallory of the Thieves Guild can help with that.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Emperor is dead and the 20,000 gold payment has been collected from Volunruud.
The gold should go toward restoring the Dawnstar Sanctuary. Delvin Mallory of the Thieves Guild can help with renovations.
The Dark Brotherhood is reborn from the Dawnstar Sanctuary. We survive, and we will thrive.
The Listener may lie about the payment amount, but the full reward stays with them regardless.

base_facts: I am Amaund Motierre, a man of considerable influence and wealth.
I contracted the Dark Brotherhood to assassinate the Emperor.
I can be found at The Bannered Mare in Whiterun.

TALK_TO_AMAUND: The true Emperor is aboard his ship, The Katariah, near Solitude's docks.
Commander Maro is at the East Empire Company Warehouse if you wish revenge.
REPORT_AND_COLLECT: The payment is in a dead drop at Volunruud, in the chamber where we first met.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Emperor is dead. The contract is fulfilled and the 20,000 gold payment was retrieved from the urn at Volunruud.
The Emperor's dying wish was for his assassin to kill the one who masterminded his assassination. Amaund may be slain to honor that request.
If killed, Amaund's last words are 'But... we had a deal...' His corpse carries a significant amount of gems.
If spared, Amaund remains at the Bannered Mare, unaware of the Emperor's final request.

beats.comment: Night Mother reveals the true Emperor must die; player must talk to Nazir then Amaund.
Player talks to Amaund Motierre at The Bannered Mare to learn the Emperor's location.
Player boards The Katariah to reach the Emperor.
Player assassinates Emperor Titus Mede II in his quarters aboard The Katariah.
Player reports the Emperor's death to Amaund and retrieves payment from Volunruud.
Player reports to Nazir at the Dawnstar Sanctuary with the gold.
Quest complete - Emperor assassinated, Dark Brotherhood restored to feared status.
